# London Deck Builder

Custom deck building, repairs, and refinishing across London ON and surrounding areas in Southwestern Ontario. PT, Cedar, Composite (Trex, TimberTech), and PVC decks. 5-year workmanship warranty on every build. Free written quotes.

## Service Areas
London, Woodstock, St. Thomas, Strathroy, Ingersoll, Dorchester, Tillsonburg, Aylmer, Lambeth, Komoka, Mount Brydges, Belmont — all in Southwestern Ontario.

## Materials
Pressure-treated, cedar, composite (Trex, TimberTech), PVC.
